svg.title: Codex Workflow and Agent Orchestration
svg.desc: Arrows show work order only. Colors and shapes match workflow nodes to the responsible role cards.
svg.text: Arrows show work order only. Colors and shapes match workflow nodes to the responsible role cards.

g.title: Codex workflow and configured agent roles
g.desc: A clear top-down delivery flow, a separate correction flow, and configured agent model and reasoning assignments.

text.data-ko: 붉은 실선은 실패, 붉은 점선은 검증 복귀입니다.
text.data-en: Solid red means failure; dashed red returns to live acceptance.
text.tspan: Solid red means failure; dashed red returns to live acceptance.

text.data-ko: 작은 표시는 역할 ID이며, 모델·추론 수준은 이 카드에만 표시합니다.
text.data-en: Small labels are role IDs; model and reasoning appear only in these cards.
text.tspan: Small labels are role IDs; model and reasoning appear only in these cards.

path.data-avoid: freeze-new-packet external-decision owner-decision-request reaudit correction-checkpoint diagnosis

text.data-ko: 같은 원인의 실패를 한 packet으로 통합
text.data-en: Consolidate failures with the same cause
text.tspan: Consolidate failures with the same cause

text.data-ko: 교정 후 실제 환경 검증으로 복귀
text.data-en: Return to live acceptance after correction
text.tspan: Return to live acceptance after correction

text.data-ko: 서브 에이전트가 아님 · 요구사항 해석, packet, 통합, 진단 소유
text.data-en: Not a sub-agent · owns interpretation, packets, integration, and diagnosis
text.tspan: Not a sub-agent · owns interpretation, packets, integration, and diagnosis

text.data-ko: Compose · DB · 브라우저 live acceptance와 최종 내부 gate 수행
text.data-en: Performs Compose, DB, browser live acceptance, and the final internal gate
text.tspan: Performs Compose, DB, browser live acceptance, and the final internal gate

text.data-ko: 구현·교정 실패를 모아 실질적으로 바뀐 packet으로 전달
text.data-en: Consolidates related failures into one materially revised packet
text.tspan: Consolidates related failures into one materially revised packet

text.data-ko: 구현 전 원문과 packet의 추적성을 독립 감사
text.data-en: Independently audits source-to-packet traceability before writing
text.tspan: Independently audits source-to-packet traceability before writing

text.data-ko: 수정 packet마다 원문·증거를 다시 열어 독립 확인
text.data-en: Reopens sources and evidence independently for every revised packet
text.tspan: Reopens sources and evidence independently for every revised packet

text.data-en: A changes_requested result blocks the writer
text.tspan: A changes_requested result blocks the writer

text.data-ko: 동결 packet의 소유 파일만 한 번에 한 명이 구현
text.data-en: One writer implements only the files owned by the frozen packet
text.tspan: One writer implements only the files owned by the frozen packet

text.data-en: Cannot reinterpret scope, broaden work, or publish a PR
text.tspan: Cannot reinterpret scope, broaden work, or publish a PR

text.data-ko: 첫 교정 때 한 번 생성 · 새 진단마다 1회 한정 수정
text.data-en: Created once at first correction · one bounded change per new diagnosis
text.tspan: Created once at first correction · one bounded change per new diagnosis

text.data-ko: 동시 writer 금지 · 거절된 접근 반복 금지
text.data-en: Never concurrent with another writer · never repeats a rejected approach
text.tspan: Never concurrent with another writer · never repeats a rejected approach

text.data-en: Returns verification to Main for independent acceptance
text.tspan: Returns verification to Main for independent acceptance

text.data-ko: 모든 gate 뒤 한 번 생성 · 재검토마다 현재 증거를 다시 확인
text.data-en: Created once after all gates · reopens current evidence on every review
text.tspan: Created once after all gates · reopens current evidence on every review

text.data-ko: UI면 모든 필수 viewport를 원본 해상도로 확인
text.data-en: For UI work, opens every required viewport at original resolution
text.tspan: For UI work, opens every required viewport at original resolution

text.data-ko: approve 전에는 게시 단계로 이동하지 않음
· auditor 포함 독립 read-only lane은 최대 3개
text.data-en: · Up to three independent read-only lanes, including the auditor
text.tspan: · Up to three independent read-only lanes, including the auditor

text.data-ko: · writer는 구현·교정을 포함해 항상 한 명씩 순차 실행
text.data-en: · Implementation and correction writers always run one at a time
text.tspan: · Implementation and correction writers always run one at a time

text.data-ko: · Main은 서브 에이전트가 아니며 모든 결과를 통합
text.data-en: · Main is not a sub-agent and consolidates every result
text.tspan: · Main is not a sub-agent and consolidates every result

text.data-ko: · 전체 한도는 회수되지 않은 thread 여유이며 생성 목표가 아님
text.data-en: · The overall limit is unreclaimed-thread headroom, not a spawning target
text.tspan: · The overall limit is unreclaimed-thread headroom, not a spawning target

text.data-ko: MAIN 파랑 · AUDIT 금색 · WRITE 청록 · FIX 빨강 · REVIEW 보라
text.data-en: MAIN blue · AUDIT gold · WRITE teal · FIX red · REVIEW purple
text.tspan: MAIN blue · AUDIT gold · WRITE teal · FIX red · REVIEW purple

text.data-ko: OWNER와 HOOK은 에이전트가 아닌 승인·게시 역할
text.data-en: OWNER and HOOK are approval/publication roles, not agents
text.tspan: OWNER and HOOK are approval/publication roles, not agents
